name: Breeze Lungs — Lift
concept: Two full, rounded lung lobes (mint + green) joined by a tall central airway topped with a bright breath-node bulb. Reads instantly as a pair of lungs taking a clean breath, lifting upward like the reference chevrons. Pure quit-smoking / fresh-air meaning, only 4 filled shapes on the exact teal-to-petrol ground.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 ground; mint #eafff6 + green #7fe3c4 lobes; mint trachea and breath bulb

name: Breeze Lungs — Column
concept: A bold, tall lung silhouette: two lobes (mint + green) hugging a short central airway, crowned by a large breath bulb. Compact and weighty for the crispest 60px silhouette of the set. Calm, confident, premium — lungs + breath in 4 shapes.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 ground; mint #eafff6 left lobe + breath bulb; green #7fe3c4 right lobe
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="lobe2_bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#0e7c86"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#063a52"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="1024" height="1024" fill="url(#lobe2_bg)"/><rect x="494" y="270" width="36" height="170" rx="18" fill="#eafff6"/><path d="M494 360 C420 360 300 420 300 600 C300 730 380 790 470 770 C500 763 494 720 494 640 Z" fill="#eafff6"/><path d="M530 360 C604 360 724 420 724 600 C724 730 644 790 554 770 C524 763 530 720 530 640 Z" fill="#7fe3c4"/><circle cx="512" cy="300" r="56" fill="#eafff6"/></svg>
_issues: Lungs + airway read clearly as breath/quit-smoking; on-style teal/mint, crisp at 60px; top circle slightly head-like but lobes anchor meaning.

name: Breeze Lungs — Rising
concept: Two upward-lifting lung lobes (mint + green) that echo the reference chevrons' rising momentum, with a detached bright breath-dot floating above — the fresh air being drawn in. Most dynamic of the three: lungs, breath and the upward lift of quitting in just 3 shapes.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 ground; mint #eafff6 left lobe + floating breath dot; green #7fe3c4 right lobe
_issues: Reads as lowercase "i", not lungs — detached dot + low joined lobes lack a trachea/bronchi junction; palette is on-brand but meaning fails.

name: Breath above the butt
concept: A short, unmistakable cigarette stub lies low across the icon (white body + bright filter tip). Rising directly above it, two bold mint and green chevrons lift upward — the smoke replaced by clean air, pure upward momentum of leaving smoking behind.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 ground; mint #eafff6 + green #7fe3c4 rising air; cigarette body #eafff6 with green #7fe3c4 filter
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="brbutt_bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#0e7c86"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#063a52"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="1024" height="1024" fill="url(#brbutt_bg)"/><path d="M512 232 L760 510 L632 510 L512 372 L392 510 L264 510 Z" fill="#eafff6"/><path d="M512 446 L724 684 L612 684 L512 568 L412 684 L300 684 Z" fill="#7fe3c4"/><rect x="300" y="760" width="424" height="104" rx="52" fill="#eafff6"/><rect x="300" y="760" width="132" height="104" rx="52" fill="#7fe3c4"/></svg>
_issues: Reads as generic double up-arrow/chevron over a pill — no smoking/breath/lung cue; palette on-brand but meaning fails, worse at 60px.

name: Rising leaf over cigarette
concept: A clear horizontal cigarette sits low with a bright green filter. Above it a single bold mint leaf rises — a clean, organic shape of fresh breath and renewal replacing the smoke, minimal and confident.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 ground; mint #eafff6 leaf; green #7fe3c4 leaf vein + cigarette filter
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="rleaf_bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#0e7c86"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#063a52"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="1024" height="1024" fill="url(#rleaf_bg)"/><path d="M512 200 C660 256 720 396 668 540 C616 636 540 660 480 632 C420 540 416 372 512 200 Z" fill="#eafff6"/><path d="M512 232 C500 392 500 520 506 608 L484 614 C476 500 484 372 512 232 Z" fill="#7fe3c4"/><rect x="288" y="764" width="448" height="108" rx="54" fill="#eafff6"/><rect x="288" y="764" width="140" height="108" rx="54" fill="#7fe3c4"/></svg>
_issues: Generic leaf reads as eco/wellness, not breath/lungs/quit-smoking; stray bottom pill confuses meaning. Palette is on-brand but concept and focal hierarchy fail.

name: Two breaths leaving smoke
concept: A short cigarette stub rests low. Above it two bold rounded air-puffs — a large mint circle and a smaller green one rising and drifting up-right — read as clean breath floating free, leaving the cigarette behind. Pure, calm, minimal.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 ground; mint #eafff6 + green #7fe3c4 breath circles; cigarette body #eafff6 with green #7fe3c4 filter
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="tbreath_bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#0e7c86"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#063a52"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="1024" height="1024" fill="url(#tbreath_bg)"/><circle cx="452" cy="408" r="168" fill="#eafff6"/><circle cx="680" cy="288" r="96" fill="#7fe3c4"/><rect x="300" y="768" width="424" height="104" rx="52" fill="#eafff6"/><rect x="300" y="768" width="132" height="104" rx="52" fill="#7fe3c4"/></svg>
_issues: Reads as abstract circles + a pill/progress-bar shape — no breath, lungs, or fresh-air cue; quit-smoking meaning not legible at 60px.

name: exhale_plume
concept: A bold solid breath plume rising and unfurling at its crown — a clean exhale of fresh air lifting upward, echoed by a smaller mint puff release beneath. Pure 'breathing out' momentum reading as freedom from smoke.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 ground; mint #eafff6 main plume, green #7fe3c4 lower puff
_issues: Reads as a smoke/vapor puff (wrong signal) plus a stray mint dot; scalloped blob turns to mush at 60px.

name: double_breath_arcs
concept: Two bold stacked breath arcs lifting upward — wide solid crescents of exhaled fresh air, the larger mint arc cresting over a smaller green one. Heavy filled silhouette reads instantly as a rising breath, not a thin wisp.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 ground; mint #eafff6 upper arc, green #7fe3c4 lower arc
_issues: Premium teal+mint style and crisp at 60px, but two nested arches read as generic abstract/rainbow — no breath/lungs/air meaning; quit-smoking link not obvious.

name: breath_drop_lift
concept: A single bold upward breath drop — a solid mint tear of fresh air rising tip-up, mirrored by a compact green drop lifting beneath it. Two clean filled forms read as a calm, deliberate exhale lifting free.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 ground; mint #eafff6 main drop, green #7fe3c4 lower drop
_issues: Two teardrops read as water/hydration, not breath/lungs/fresh air — quit-smoking meaning absent; palette and minimalism are on-brand.

name: Single rising leaf
concept: One bold mint leaf rising on a green stem — a clean veined leaf shape reading as fresh life and healthy lungs lifting upward, the single-shape minimalism of the reference chevron translated into pure new growth.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 ground; mint leaf #eafff6, green stem #7fe3c4
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="leafA_bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#0e7c86"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#063a52"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="1024" height="1024" fill="url(#leafA_bg)"/><path d="M512 232 C660 360 700 520 588 700 C548 588 540 460 512 360 C484 460 476 588 436 700 C324 520 364 360 512 232 Z" fill="#eafff6"/><rect x="486" y="640" width="52" height="160" rx="26" fill="#7fe3c4"/></svg>
_issues: Reads as a leaf or upward white flame/teardrop, not breath/lungs/fresh-air — flame shape is risky for a quit-smoking app; stem detail and veins muddy at 60px; palette OK but main shape is off-white not hero mint and gradient bottoms out too dark.

name: Two-leaf sprout
concept: A bold two-leaf sprout opening upward and outward — mint leaf and green leaf splitting from one base, echoing the reference's paired-shape rhythm. Pure freshness and the lift of a new beginning, only two filled shapes.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 ground; mint leaf #eafff6, green leaf #7fe3c4
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="leafB_bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#0e7c86"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#063a52"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="1024" height="1024" fill="url(#leafB_bg)"/><path d="M512 792 C512 600 600 470 760 430 C764 632 668 760 512 792 Z" fill="#eafff6"/><path d="M512 792 C512 620 432 500 288 460 C284 648 372 766 512 792 Z" fill="#7fe3c4"/></svg>
_issues: Reads as two abstract leaves/butterfly — no breath, lung, or fresh-air cue; style on-brand but meaning generic.

name: Sprout with stem
concept: A tall mint leaf paired with a small green side leaf on a short green stem — a young sprout reaching up. Three bold filled shapes, the most literal 'fresh life growing' read while keeping the reference's premium minimal weight.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 ground; mint main leaf #eafff6, green leaf and stem #7fe3c4
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="leafC_bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#0e7c86"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#063a52"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="1024" height="1024" fill="url(#leafC_bg)"/><path d="M512 224 C672 312 720 512 568 720 C508 560 508 400 512 224 Z" fill="#eafff6"/><path d="M456 760 C312 700 280 540 380 412 C476 520 488 632 456 760 Z" fill="#7fe3c4"/><rect x="490" y="700" width="44" height="104" rx="22" fill="#7fe3c4"/></svg>
_issues: Reads as a generic leaf/plant (eco/wellness), not lungs/breath/fresh-air; teal+mint palette fits but quit-smoking meaning isn't obvious and the off-center leaves + tiny detached stem look unbalanced.

name: Breeze — Lungs Lifting Into Wings
concept: Two bold filled lung-lobes meet at a central airway and sweep outward and upward at their tops into wing-tips — reading at once as healthy open lungs and as wings lifting. Pure upward momentum, breath and freedom from quitting.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 vertical ground; mint #eafff6 main lung-wings; green #7fe3c4 inner breath core
_issues: Lungs + mint sprout read instantly as healthy breathing; on-style teal/mint minimal. Central leaf is a touch small and may blur into the trachea gap at 60px — enlarge/simplify it for max clarity.

name: Breeze — Open Breath, Twin Wing-Lobes
concept: Two symmetrical filled lobes lift off a narrow central trachea-stem, their upper edges angled into clean wing sweeps. A small mint breath-mark rises through the center channel, reading as fresh air drawn into healing lungs taking flight.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 vertical ground; green #7fe3c4 lung-wing lobes; mint #eafff6 rising central breath-stem
_issues: Reads as generic leaves/wings, not lungs/breath; thin center stalk muddies at 60px. Palette is on-brand but meaning unclear.

name: Breeze — Heart-Lungs Wing Lift
concept: A single bold heart-shaped lung silhouette whose two upper humps extend into outward wing-points and whose base lifts to a sharp upward apex — combining healthy lungs, the heart of breathing, and the lift of wings into one clean filled mark. A green inner core marks the breath drawn in.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 to petrol #063a52 vertical ground; mint #eafff6 heart-lung wing body; green #7fe3c4 inner breath core
_issues: Lungs intent reads as a heart/butterfly; thin mint trachea + hairline side strokes vanish at 60px — meaning ambiguous despite on-brand teal/mint palette.

name: Breeze — Crossed Cigarette Lift
concept: A bold horizontal cigarette (mint body, green filter, soft ember tip) struck through by a thick mint diagonal slash. The slash rises left-to-right, giving an upward-lift read: quit + ascent. Only the cigarette and the slash — pure no-smoking sign in the reference's filled-shape language.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 → petrol #063a52 ground; mint #eafff6 cigarette body + slash; green #7fe3c4 filter
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="cigslash_bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#0e7c86"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#063a52"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="1024" height="1024" fill="url(#cigslash_bg)"/><rect x="232" y="452" width="440" height="120" rx="24" fill="#eafff6"/><rect x="672" y="452" width="120" height="120" rx="24" fill="#7fe3c4"/><path d="M312 760 L680 264 L772 332 L404 828 Z" fill="#eafff6"/></svg>
_issues: Slash and cigarette are same white (#eafff6) so they fuse into one shape — the "crossed-out cigarette" doesn't read; give the slash a teal gap/stroke and tilt the cigarette off pure-horizontal.

name: Breeze — Snapped Cigarette Rising
concept: A snapped cigarette: two stub halves (mint body, green filter) angled apart so the break forms an upward V — the snap itself reads as the lift of quitting. A single bold green chevron crowns it for the reference's rising-breath momentum. Three clean filled shapes, no slash needed — the break is the statement.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 → petrol #063a52 ground; mint #eafff6 cigarette body; green #7fe3c4 filter + ascent chevron
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="snapcig_bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#0e7c86"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#063a52"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="1024" height="1024" fill="url(#snapcig_bg)"/><path d="M204 720 L470 560 L420 474 L154 634 Z" fill="#eafff6"/><path d="M120 670 L204 720 L154 634 Z" fill="#7fe3c4"/><path d="M820 720 L554 560 L604 474 L870 634 Z" fill="#eafff6"/><path d="M512 256 L660 412 L584 412 L512 336 L440 412 L364 412 Z" fill="#7fe3c4"/></svg>
_issues: Reads as abstract chevrons/up-arrow, not a snapped cigarette; no breath/lung/air cue; fragments and loses meaning at 60px. Palette is on-brand but the symbol fails the quit-smoking read.

name: Breeze — No-Smoking Disc with Lift
concept: The universal no-smoking read at icon scale: a thick mint ring enclosing a short green cigarette, struck by a bold mint diagonal bar. The whole disc sits slightly high with the bar angled upward — calm, confident, instantly legible as 'no smoking + rise'. Ring, cigarette, bar: minimal and crisp at 60px.
palette: deep teal #0e7c86 → petrol #063a52 ground; mint #eafff6 ring + slash bar; green #7fe3c4 cigarette
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><linearGradient id="nosmokedisc_bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#0e7c86"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#063a52"/></linearGradient><clipPath id="nosmokedisc_clip"><circle cx="512" cy="500" r="232"/></clipPath></defs><rect width="1024" height="1024" fill="url(#nosmokedisc_bg)"/><path d="M512 232 A268 268 0 1 1 511.99 232 Z M512 320 A180 180 0 1 0 512.01 320 Z" fill="#eafff6" fill-rule="evenodd"/><rect x="360" y="462" width="304" height="76" rx="16" fill="#7fe3c4" clip-path="url(#nosmokedisc_clip)"/><path d="M330 690 L654 282 L726 339 L402 747 Z" fill="#eafff6" clip-path="url(#nosmokedisc_clip)"/></svg>
